w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: The Redactor stops at the boundary — pacing, unwilling. Something else is already here. It's still out there.

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: The landlord is stamping the ground. Each stamp lands like a gavel. The tiles it marks start to feel wrong under your feet.

w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Emma just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🐗 RAID — 3 raiders (The Ugly Beast, Chorus Line, Spool) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! The palisade's stakes take their toll as they come over the wall.

w3Mentions.name: The Terms of Service
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Terms of Service.

w3Mentions.name: Buffering
w3Mentions.firstLine: A frame of it hangs in the air. Then another. It's buffering.

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: ⚔ AD BREAK! You're on your own.

w5Mentions.name: The Nielsen
w5Mentions.firstLine: ◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
firstContext: 📺 SYSTEM: "EVERYONE. SIT. WATCH. The teeth and the weather can WAIT — nothing out there matters until this is done. ...Did I stutter? SIT."
◈ ABILITY — Dreadfield: The room feels you before you speak. Alien-terror starts at 2.
◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
◈ ABILITY — Oathbound: Your terror is pledged as a shield: your own people's horror grows half as fast.
◈ ABILITY — Shieldbearer: Spend terror to calm horror — the shield, not the sword. (Offered in the final beat.)

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. The Paparazzo is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. The Big Beast is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.

📺 SYSTEM: "CONTEST: Siege. Hold the chokepoint for three waves while the village watches from the walls. The line holds, or you don't."

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — regional standing, waves 1–3 faced (13/10/6), with 3 wave-4 fought, 7 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — Regional Standing 38/40 to National Standing (Fight 2 · Forage 1 · Craft 0 · Talk 7 · Explore 25 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus) — short 2; capped: Explore
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TENDER — YOU TEACH MORE THAN YOU TAKE. I AM... KEEPING UP. BARELY. DO NOT SLOW DOWN ON MY ACCOUNT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; the relay carried faithfully. The light road is open.

firenarr.line: ⚠ The store has fallen far from its recent high again — the shelves are nearly bare.
⚠ The store keeps slipping from its recent high again — evening after evening, lower.
⚠ The store has fallen further still from its recent high.

hurtreturn.line: 🧭 Emma returns from the wilds hurt (health 3/100) — the trip cut short.
🧭 Stan returns from the wilds hurt (health 6/100) — the trip cut short.

ladderLines.line: 🍖 THE BUNDLE — no feast tonight, no guests: 8,288 kcal of pantry stores bought the bundle outright. Six different gifts, paid for in food. The ladder counts it.
It wants the job itself: caretaking, as a practice. This is the ask the whole ladder was climbing toward.
